To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

concomitant administration with chemotherapy of Lentinula Edodes Mycelia Extract (LEM), a dietary supplement, was effective in decreasing adverse events from cancer chemotherapy among advanced gastric and colorectal cancer patients.
Lentinula edode s mycelia extract can reduce adverse events from chemotherapy and increase IFN-γ secretion in CD4 ^{+} T, CD8 ^{+} T and CD56 ^{+} NK/NKT cells.

Lentinula edode s mycelia extract can be used safely in combination with chemotherapy to reduce the incidence of adverse events from cancer chemotherapy in advanced cancer patients, and that LEM can improve the immune function of patients receiving chemotherapy.
